fact.en: Do not confuse Sangam-era rock-cut art with the later Pallava monolithic rathas.
fact.hi: Do not confuse Sangam-era rock-cut art with the later Pallava monolithic rathas.

fact.en: Sangam architecture was primarily perishable (wood/brick/mud); stone temples are mostly post-Sangam.

fact.en: Avoid assuming Dravidian 'Gopurams' existed in the Sangam age; these are medieval evolutions.
